_comment: Health-altering buffs/debuffs on players (sim.js applyStatus). Key order is the network code — append new ones at the END. Fields: type buff|debuff; hps = HP per second per stack (negative = damage over time, routed through hurt() as DoT so shields/armour rules match); dmgTakenM / healM multiply incoming damage / healing (strongest active wins per side, they don't stack); maxhpM scales max HP while active (the bonus is added on apply and removed exactly on expiry); dur seconds, refreshed on re-apply; maxStacks caps hps stacking. color/glyph drive the HUD chip, bar overlays and world particles (hudfx.js, render.js).
